notes: Clip reliability: replay hardening — stale clip URLs are revoked before new ones load, preload=metadata on replay videos, and sync listeners can no longer stack up across recordings.

NEW Double-check: re-runs the AI analysis on your saved clip and tells you whether both checks agree or disagree, so you know when to trust the number or retake.
